metadata.question: Does Australia show higher carbon monoxide concentration than Indonesia in October 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: Use Sentinel-5P for carbon monoxide data. The relevant band is 'CO_column_number_density' which provides tropospheric CO concentration. 2. Masking: For CO data, we typically don't need cloud masking as it's not optical imagery. The data is from a spectrometer. 3. Logic: Compare mean CO concentration between Australia and Indonesia in October 2024. Steps: - Define geometries for Australia and Indonesia - Get Sentinel-5P CO data for October 2024 - Check if collections have data - Calculate mean CO concentration for each country - Compare values and determine answer Potential issues: - October 2024 might not have data yet (as of 2024), so we might get C1 - Need to validate the values are reasonable (not NaN, within expected range) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var australia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0').filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Australia')); var indonesia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0').filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Indonesia')); var startDate = '2024-10-01'; var endDate = '2024-10-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P CO data var ausCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(australia) .select('CO_column_number_density'); var indoCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(indonesia) .select('CO_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes var ausSize = ausCollection.size().getInfo(); var indoSize = indoCollection.size().getInfo(); print(`Australia images: ${ausSize}, Indonesia images: ${indoSize}`); if (ausSize === 0 || indoSize === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean CO concentration var ausMean = ausCollection.mean(); var indoMean = indoCollection.mean(); // Reduce regions to get mean values var ausStats = ausMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: australia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var indoStats = indoMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: indonesia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var ausData = ausStats.getInfo(); var indoData = indoStats.getInfo(); var ausCo = ausData.CO_column_number_density; var indoCo = indoData.CO_column_number_density; var ausCount = ausData.CO_column_number_density_count; var indoCount = indoData.CO_column_number_density_count; print(`Australia CO: ${ausCo?.toFixed(6) || 'null'}, Pixels: ${ausCount}`); print(`Indonesia CO: ${indoCo?.toFixed(6) || 'null'}, Pixels: ${indoCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (ausCount === 0 || indoCount === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (ausCo === null || indoCo === null || isNaN(ausCo) || isNaN(indoCo) || ausCo < 0 || indoCo < 0 || ausCo > 0.1 || indoCo > 0.1) { print("C3"); } else if (ausCo > indoCo) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
